summary: Frontend-only regression of the landing overhaul (items 3–8). Tested situation picker (6 options + result flow + routing), three-reports strip, legal ack behaviour on landing + gated pages, rewired hero CTAs (watch, guest), and dashboard 'More resources' collapsible behaviour for new vs returning users. Also verified brand sweep: no 'SA Coparents' (lowercase p) remains anywhere under /app/frontend or /app/backend. All acceptance criteria met EXCEPT one: clicking situation-high-conflict does NOT render the safety banner even though the spec explicitly requires it.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec: 'Clicking situation-high-conflict also shows the safety banner (Ongoing high conflict deserves a private safety screen BEFORE cooperation work)'. Actual: The high-conflict SITUATIONS entry has no `safetyBanner` field, so [data-testid=situation-picker-safety-banner] does NOT render. Confirmed via automated test — banner=False for high-conflict, banner=True for safety. Fix: add `safetyBanner: 'If you are in immediate danger, call 911. Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: 988. National Domestic Violence Hotline: 1-800-799-SAFE.'` to the high-conflict result object at /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx around line 317-325 (mirror the safety entry).

action_items: Add safetyBanner property to the high-conflict SITUATIONS entry in /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx so the orange 911/988/1-800-799-SAFE banner also appears when parents pick 'We experience ongoing high conflict'. All other items passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx is now ~1500+ lines and heavy — consider splitting SituationPicker, ThreeReportsStrip, AssessmentSelector, SampleReports into their own files for maintainability.

AssessmentSelector still references useEnterApp().enter which no longer exists in the provider (only enterAssessments/enterGuest/watchIntro/enterWithFocus). If this section is ever rendered on the landing, clicking assessment-selector-cta will throw. Consider either wiring it to enterAssessments/enterWithFocus or removing the dead component.

rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx the SITUATIONS array defines a `safetyBanner` string only on the `safety` entry (line ~338). The `high-conflict` entry (line ~313) has body copy that references safety-first invariants but does not include a `safetyBanner` field. The SituationPicker result renderer at line ~431 only shows [data-testid=situation-picker-safety-banner] when `picked.result.safetyBanner` is truthy — so high-conflict silently falls through. Reproduction: open /, click [data-testid=situation-high-conflict], observe absence of [data-testid=situation-picker-safety-banner]. Mitigation: add the identical safetyBanner string to the high-conflict entry.
